title: Man-made UFO down in Russia

tellings.quote: uh apparently a man-made UFO that went down in Russia. We've gotten that confirmed recently from a [snorts] special operations team.

plain: A UFO built by humans, not by anyone from elsewhere, went down in Russia, according to Steven Greer, a UFO researcher who argues that UFO secrets are held by a global cabal. Greer tells Michels this was recently "confirmed" to his group by a special operations team he does not name. If true, it would mean some people already build craft of the kind usually called UFOs.
